system.description:
When casting jutsu that bombards an area with their effects, you are able to modify their shapes slightly. You gain the following benefits:

Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you cast that affects an area with a duration of Instant, leaves behind a lingering effect, until the beginning of your next turn. Hostile creatures that enter the affected area for the first time on a turn, suffer the effects of your jutsu as if they only Succeeded.

Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you cast that affects an area that normally does not allow you to choose creatures to affect, allows you now select one creature to make immune to your jutsu’s effects.

Evocation Ability – Motion Wave. While wielding a Combat Scroll, Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you cast that affects an area that has a duration and normally cannot be moved, can be moved as an Action. A jutsu can only be moved once in this way per casting. Creatures in the newly affected area makes their save as if they were in the original affected area.
system.requirement: Have a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu who’s area of effect is in the shape of a Sphere, Cube, Cone, Cylinder or Line, on your known list.
